messages:
Maria C.: heads up — Aster Labs is ready for early access, they hit the invite link but flagged SSO errors. i opened intake ticket: https://redwood.example/tickets/1234
Sam E.: thanks, Maria. can you paste the exact error? SSO provider is Okta or OneLogin?
Maria C.: they said 'invalid_assertion' in Okta. sent logs in ticket. looks like SP metadata mismatch.
Oliver S.: tagging @Sam E. — i'll push the federation config change. ETA ~30m.
Jess O.: schedule enablement 1:1 once SSO green. prefer Wed 9am PT. @calendar-bot can you check Aster's timezone and propose slots?
calendar-bot: Proposed slots: Wed 9am PT / Thu 11am PT / Fri 2pm PT — accept with `/book Wed 9am PT`.
Sam E.: changed SP metadata — please retry, Maria.
Maria C.: retry worked! user can log in. thanks :tada: 
Jess O.: booking enablement for Wed 9am PT. sending join link and pre-read (2 bullet checklist) — will include runbook and short feedback form.
Maria C.: FYI Aster asked about production-ready throughput; flagged as renewal risk if perf not validated. can we run a short perf check on their sample workload?
Oliver S.: yes. can run a 15-min smoke with Dedicated config: batch=16, seq=512. i'll spin a job and post results.
Oliver S.: smoke run done — p95 latency 220ms, tokens/sec ~320 — posted logs in ticket.
Maria C.: shared with customer, they replied "good start, want lower latency for interactive use" — adding to feedback loop.
Sam E.: recommend trying KV cache warm and reduce batch to 8 for interactivity. will test.
Sam E.: test done: p95 160ms with batch=8. tagging @Jess O. for customer update.
Jess O.: great. i'll include as part of the enablement deck and add a field in CRM for 'renewal_risk: moderate' and next check-in in 30 days.
Maria C.: capturing note and closing intake ticket. follow-up: capture NPS after 2 weeks.
Maria C.: (reaction) :white_check_mark:
